decision: Accept this original SURYA static art checkpoint in the actual native renderer; no blocking asset defect found in the six reviewed views. Motion/input and package acceptance remain their owners' gates.

actual_render.scope: Actual native rendered screens and geometry. Fixture authority states stage plant/results for art review; not natural gameplay/input or hardware performance proof.

findings.surya-left.png: Open curved stock is a real through-space; magazine/grip/trigger guard separate cleanly; side chamber facets and brass frames read; six ribs support the barrel.
findings.surya-right.png: Opposite side carries coherent matching relief/lattice and stock opening; no missing backface or disconnected plate is apparent at this view.
findings.surya-muzzle.png: Front ring/bore, crown petals and barrel collars remain coherent in the oblique front view; no flat image projection.
findings.05-a-approach.png: Hero-distance indigo/brass break and warm chamber survive the actual map lighting. The butt is visibly solid rubber, with the open stock readable beside it.
findings.06-aim-down-sights.png: Root's forward aimed pose reduces the black butt-pad projection versus R3; clear target region remains above the sights. Hands and butt still occupy lower center as visible in the original.
findings.06b-reload.png: Tilt exposes chamber, stock loop and separated moving magazine in the staged43percent reload pose. This still is not continuous transition evidence.

structural_receipt.note: Above initial approximate30–70k target; retained for this visual checkpoint. No hardware performance inference.

limits: Only six named R4 stills and three earlier R3 comparison stills reviewed by this worker for the gun.
